name: border-beam
title: Border beam
description: A thin bordered box with a light that travels around its edge. CSS only.
a11y: The beam is aria-hidden and decorative; the content keeps its normal reading order.
The beam is hidden under prefers-reduced-motion, leaving a plain thin border.
